design_decisions.title: generated_platform_facts_are_consistent
constraints: tool/generate_agent_indexes.js remains the only edited source of generated platform metadata.
AI_MODULE_INDEX.md, module AI_ANALYSIS.md, app_route_table.dart and AI_PROJECT_CONTEXT.md must be regenerated, never hand-edited.
Every module with supportedPlatforms in the generator must expose the same normalized platform list in generated module index and module contract.
Modules without supportedPlatforms remain all-platform by the existing contract; do not add speculative restrictions.

design_decisions.title: workspace_members_match_root_manifest
constraints: Generated repository.members must match the actual root workspace declaration, including packages/desktop_multi_window if it is a workspace member.
Do not convert external or vendored packages into workspace members unless the root manifest already declares them.
Preserve dependency direction and do not change runtime package dependencies as part of index repair.

design_decisions.title: web_is_planned_not_supported
constraints: Do not add Web to supportedPlatforms for webview, online_video_player or file_picker merely because transitive packages contain Web implementations.
Do not create apps/flutter_forge/web, Web backends, Web CI, release artifacts or runtime code in this task.

If the existing project-contract schema supports a target/planned distinction, record Web as planned and remove iOS from the active target list; otherwise leave runtime target facts unchanged and document only a bounded Web follow-up in the generated source's existing planning structure.
Linux remains out of scope and must not be added to target_hosts or module support metadata.

implementation_steps.detail: Re-check git status, branch tracking, HEAD/origin refs, read AGENTS.md, AI_ANALYSIS_SCHEMA.json, AI_PROJECT_CONTEXT.md, REFACTOR_PLAN.md, and inspect generator/index/module contracts. If the baseline has moved or unrelated changes exist, stop without staging them.

Patch only tool/generate_agent_indexes.js and, if required by the existing contract, the smallest machine-contract source fields needed to represent the agreed Android/macOS/Windows/Web target boundary. Keep generated files out of direct edits.

Run bash tool/generate_harness_ai_analysis.sh. Confirm generated AI_MODULE_INDEX contains supported_platforms for all restricted modules, generated module contracts match, route metadata remains consistent, and repository.members matches root pubspec workspace members.
Add or update focused generator/validator regression coverage only if needed to prevent the exact platform-index drift from returning. Do not weaken validators or alter accepted architecture goldens.

Before commit, run node --check tool/generate_agent_indexes.js, node tool/validate_agent_docs.js, bash tool/check_generated_docs.sh, git diff --check, and inspect the complete diff. Then run bash tool/quality_gate.sh after all intended files are staged because the gate checks generated/format drift relative to HEAD.

Stage only the generator, generated machine contracts, focused regression tests, and this task JSON if it is part of the repository convention. Create one local commit with message fix(agent-docs): align platform metadata indexes. Do not push. Verify the commit file list and origin/dev remains unchanged.
